Title: [LSJ] Herald of Topeth playing Legal Manipulations

Messages.Author: Jyhad_addict
Messages.Body:
The Herald can play cards that require basic presence as a vampire of
capacity....bla...bla...bla...
So, if he bleeds with Legal Manipulations, is he considered a
vampire for the duration of the action, thus can be blocked by a
vampire "wearing" Memories of Mortality, or not ?
i'd say not, because i believe what is meant by card text, is that
he is treated as a vampire of x capacity, for purposes of playing the
card e.g. blood cost, e.t.c. So, he is treated as a vampire for
purposes of playing the card, but is treated as an ally for the
purposes of performing the action (block attempts, e.t.c.), right ?

i understand what "...may play cards like a vampire of capacity x"
means. it means for example that if a minion with this text can play
e.g. basic tha as a vampire, then if he plays burst of sunlight he
will take the 1 aggra damage, because he plays the card as a vampire.
But by playing a combat card he is treated as a vampire for a moment
only, what confuses me is what happens when an ally with such a text
plays an action card as a vampire, as the action has a duration and is
not an instantaneous effect.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"Jyhad_addict" <geo...@for.auth.gr> wrote in message
news:c6a50f81.04101...@posting.google.com...

> The Herald can play cards that require basic presence as a vampire of
> capacity....bla...bla...bla...
> So, if he bleeds with Legal Manipulations, is he considered a
> vampire for the duration of the action, thus can be blocked by a

Only Legal Manipulations treats him "as a vampire". All other
effects treat him as the ally he is.

> vampire "wearing" Memories of Mortality, or not ?

Not.

> i'd say not, because i believe what is meant by card text, is that
> he is treated as a vampire of x capacity, for purposes of playing the
> card e.g. blood cost, e.t.c. So, he is treated as a vampire for
> purposes of playing the card, but is treated as an ally for the
> purposes of performing the action (block attempts, e.t.c.), right ?

Correct.

> i understand what "...may play cards like a vampire of capacity x"
> means. it means for example that if a minion with this text can play
> e.g. basic tha as a vampire, then if he plays burst of sunlight he
> will take the 1 aggra damage, because he plays the card as a vampire.
> But by playing a combat card he is treated as a vampire for a moment
> only, what confuses me is what happens when an ally with such a text
> plays an action card as a vampire, as the action has a duration and is
> not an instantaneous effect.

Not "for the moment", but "for that card".
See http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/rulebook/rulebook.html#sec1_6_3
